skill.summary: Preserve critical session context while reducing token use in long-running agent work.

content.value_statement: Long AI sessions can lose important decisions, files, and next steps during compression. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code preserve working context with structured summaries and probes.
actual_capabilities: Explains anchored iterative summarization for long-running sessions.
Defines summary sections for intent, files, decisions, state, and next steps.
Compares anchored, opaque, and regenerative compression approaches.
Provides trigger strategies for context window management.
Describes probe-based evaluation for compression quality.
Highlights artifact trail tracking as a key compression risk.
limitations: It provides guidance and templates, not an automated compression engine.
It does not inspect live repositories or conversation logs by itself.
Opaque compression details are discussed conceptually, not implemented.
Compression quality still depends on accurate source context.

use_cases.title: Preserve Coding Session State
use_cases.description: Create summaries that retain changed files, decisions, tests, blockers, and next actions before context limits are reached.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Summary Quality
use_cases.description: Build probe questions that test whether compressed context can still answer key task questions.

use_cases.title: Plan Large Codebase Workflows
use_cases.description: Use research, planning, and implementation phases to compress large codebase exploration into usable specifications.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Session Summary
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner compression for an active work session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a structured compression summary for this session. Include session intent, files changed, decisions, current state, and next steps.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a Compression Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Select the right approach for a long-running task.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare anchored iterative, opaque, and regenerative compression for this task. Recommend one strategy and explain the trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Design Evaluation Probes
prompt_templates.scenario: Test whether a compressed summary preserves useful context.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design probe questions for this compressed summary. Cover recall, artifact tracking, continuation, decisions, and instruction following.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Compression Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design for large codebases or agent systems.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a three-phase compression workflow for this project. Include trigger points, summary sections, artifact tracking, and quality checks.

output_examples.input: A debugging session is near the context limit after tracing an authentication failure.
output_examples.output: The skill would produce a structured summary with the error, root cause, files inspected, files changed, tests, and next actions.

output_examples.input: A team needs to compare compression strategies for a long coding workflow.
output_examples.output: The skill would compare compression ratio, quality, interpretability, and refetching risk for each strategy.

output_examples.input: A platform engineer wants to validate whether summaries preserve task state.
output_examples.output: The skill would suggest probe questions that check facts, artifacts, decisions, continuity, and instruction compliance.

best_practices: Use stable summary sections that match the work being compressed.
Track files, decisions, and next steps as first-class summary fields.
Evaluate compression with task probes, not only token savings.
anti_patterns: Compressing aggressively without checking whether task-critical facts remain.
Regenerating full summaries repeatedly when incremental merging would preserve history better.
Treating file tracking as ordinary prose instead of explicit artifact state.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps preserve important context when long AI sessions must be summarized or compressed.

faq.question: Does it run code or install software?
faq.answer: No. The skill is documentation and guidance for designing compression strategies.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: It is marked for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: When should I activate it?
faq.answer: Use it when a long task approaches context limits or needs reliable session summaries.

faq.question: How does it measure quality?
faq.answer: It recommends probe questions that test whether compressed context still supports useful work.

faq.question: What is its main limitation?
faq.answer: It does not compress context automatically. It guides the design and evaluation process.
